svg.title: RetiSEM
svg.desc: Photorealistic illustrative biomedical data workspace with authentic retinal vessel topology and a native schematic of lipid exposure L, retinal traits R and systemic outcomes V. Lines show pathways considered by the model, not estimated or established causal effects.
